motions.description: Approve the consent agenda items including minutes, bills and vouchers, license applications, and various ordinances and resolutions.
Approve a proclamation issued by President Saviano proclaiming April 25, 2025 Arbor Day in the Village of Elmwood Park.
Approve a request from Lois Gates, Misericordia Executive Director, for permission to hold 'Jelly Belly Days' on April 25th and 26th, 2025 at various locations in the village.
Receive and file a recommendation to approve a text amendment application amending the Elmwood Park Zoning Code and a Special Use application for a Bakery at 7717-19 W Belmont Avenue.
Approve an Ordinance Amending Section 1407.03, Entitled 'Permitted and Special Uses in Business, Commercial and Mixed Use Districts,' of the Zoning Code of the Village of Elmwood Park.

Approve an Ordinance to Approve and Grant a Special Use Permit to Operate a Bakery with Processing for On-Premises Sales only at the Property Commonly known as 7717-7719 Belmont Avenue, Elmwood Park, Illinois.
